H01.description: Header comment documenting the new host-mode opt-in.

H03.description: Header comment documenting size cap and symlink filtering.

H04.description: Header comment update for base tree and tar filtering.

H05.description: Header comment documenting harness removal, container hardening and output cap.

H06.description: Header comment documenting node-path reading, regressions and refactor semantics.

H07.description: Header comment documenting bounded symlink-refusing reads.

H08.description: Header comment on refactor verdict accuracy.

H09.description: Header comment on contamination path rules.

H10.description: Header comment on grade.json schema and version history.

H12.description: Imports, version bump and constants (HARNESS_NAMES, caps, timeout knob) supporting the hardening fixes.

H13.description: remove_path chmods every walked directory entry with os.chmod, which follows an agent-planted symlink and changes the mode of a directory outside the grading tree.

H14.description: Adds the bounded O_NOFOLLOW reader helper and OVERSIZED counter used by the fixes.

H15.description: copy_tree recreates every symlink from the agent's sandbox verbatim, including absolute or tree-escaping links that commands and later steps then follow outside the grading tree.

H16.description: A directory symlink is recreated in the grading tree regardless of whether its target escapes the tree.

H17.description: A file symlink is recreated regardless of an escaping target (and regular files of any size are copied densely, e.g. a sparse 1 TB file).

H18.description: Records the structural check's source path for the refactor grading fix.

H19.description: Counts the structural check's static cases for the refactor grading fix.

H20.description: The pytest invocation honours an agent-written ini file's addopts, letting the agent inject plugins or deselect hidden tests.

H21.description: The grading container runs unnamed without pid/memory/cpu limits, capability drop, init or a kill-after deadline, so a hung or forking agent program cannot be reliably stopped or cleaned up.

H22.description: subprocess.run captures unbounded output and on client timeout leaves the container running (no kill/rm) and misses 137 kills as timeouts.

H23.description: def_line opens any node path printed by code under test (absolute, outside the tree, a FIFO or device) and reads it whole, allowing hangs or reads outside the tree.

H24.description: Collection-error expansion opens an agent-printed path unbounded and unchecked (FIFO, /dev/zero, path above the tree).

H25.description: Caller updated for exec_in_tree's new return tuple.

H27.description: all_pass treats a run as green ignoring the exit status and timeout, so a passing TAP block followed by exit 1 or a timed-out run counts as green.

H28.description: prepare leaves agent-written conftest.py, ini files and bats helpers/setup_suite in the grading tree, so the agent can make failing hidden tests pass.

H30.description: Snapshot extraction writes tar members of any size, so a huge file in a snapshot is materialised in full.

H31.description: data_filter judges members in archive order, so a snapshot symlink escaping via a later link survives extraction.

H32.description: Marker object for oversized files in churn.

H33.description: churn reads every file whole into memory with no size bound or file-type check.

H34.description: Counts oversized files as changed in churn.

H35.description: gate_verdict follows a symlinked feedback file (os.path.isfile + open) and reads it unbounded, so an agent can point the verdict at an outside file or a FIFO.

H36.description: review_md_verdict follows a symlinked review.md and reads it unbounded.

H37.description: Envelope JSON is read without size bound or non-blocking regular-file check.

H38.description: Citation sources are read whole without a size cap or a check that the path resolves inside the sandbox (a symlinked parent is followed).

H39.description: Adds HOME_WORD and SENSITIVE patterns for the contamination fix.

H40.description: Host-mode contamination scan exempts the caller's credential stores (~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.aws), so reading them is never flagged.

H41.description: outside() treats ~/ and $HOME/ paths and /proc/<pid>/environ or /var/run as allowed, missing credential reaches.

H42.description: Bash scanning ignores home-relative words and skips every one-component /x/ word as a regex, so `cd /root/` or `cat ~/.aws/credentials` is never flagged.

H43.description: Caller updated for gate_verdict's new root parameter.

H44.description: Caller updated for review_md_verdict's new root parameter.

H45.description: For refactor tasks hidden_tests is the fixture suite rather than the structural check (an untouched tree scores 1.0), and the regression logic mis-handles an unparseable base or final run.

H46.description: Snapshot trees for refactor gates are judged by test_command alone instead of the structural check plus suite, so per-gate verdict accuracy is wrong.

H47.description: Records the oversized-files count in grade.json.

H48.description: Self-check judges green by pass counts only (ignoring exit status, timeout and parse errors) and uses the old refactor structural split.

H49.description: --executor host runs agent code on the host as the calling user without isolation and without any opt-in or warning.

H50.description: Header comment for the new validation rules.

H51.description: Usage line range extended to cover the longer header.

H52.description: validate-suite accepts a refactor task with a regression_command, which conflicts with test_command being the refactor regression check.

H53.description: validate-suite does not require grader_protected to list every fixture/tests file, so agent-edited fixture tests are not restored before grading.

H54.description: Test setup opts into host mode.

H60.description: Adds regression tests AG-19 to AG-28.

H64.description: Test stub accepts new docker flags.

H66.description: Adds validate-suite tests VS-12 and VS-13.
